output_list.code: function sell(uint256 amount) public { require(this.balance >= amount * sellPrice); _transfer(this, msg.sender, amount); msg.sender.transfer(amount * sellPrice); }
output_list.vulnerability: Allow attackers to sell tokens with 0 value
output_list.reason:
In `sell` function, amount of tokens can be transferred to ether 0 value, which will be considered as loss in users pocket.
A quick fix is reject transfers of 0 values

output_list.code: function buy() payable public { uint amount = msg.value / buyPrice; _transfer(this, msg.sender, amount); }
output_list.vulnerability: Token Price Can Be Lower Than Existing Price
output_list.reason:
There is no valid error checking for the transfer of 0 tokens in the 'buy' function.
Tokens that cost 0 will be sold at a discount from the buying price.
